svg.title: Blood-Enchanted Eyes — Crimson Covenant
svg.desc: Structural portrait layout with exact current mechanics and blank illustration spaces. Four independent foundations, four Hidden Arts, four Advanced Arts, five BP maximum.
svg.text: Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%.
Damage is raw power: a 40-power jutsu with +3 Damage becomes 43.
Afterburn adds extra damage when the target receives a qualifying hit.
